catalogue_metadata.scope_notes: Extraction focused on Continuous Architecture Steering (CAS) runner, automated governance agents, LLM client abstractions, and knowledge lifecycle management.
analysis_limits: No full step-level implementation bodies inspected beyond symbols in manifest
Analysis relies on key files, symbol declarations, and architecture documents in repo

system_map.overview: The CAS (Continuous Architecture Steering) system coordinates agentic analysis, automated governance rule evaluation, and capability synchronization across Git repositories. It uses a centralized FlowRunner to orchestrate LLM-driven merges, compliance validation, and architectural delta extraction into structured knowledge graphs.

agents.name: AgenticMerger
agents.role: Synthesizes and resolves branch changes, governance policies, and architectural documentation conflicts via LLM reasoning.

agents.name: ComplianceEngine
agents.role: Evaluates architectural and repository changes against formalized governance constraints and compliance rules.

agents.name: GovernanceActionEngine
agents.role: Executes state transitions, policy enforcement tasks, and governance actions based on transition registry specifications.

orchestration.description: FlowRunner coordinates pipeline execution sequentially across bootstrap, delta ingestion, LLM analysis, and governance compliance reporting.

tools_and_integrations.name: LiteLLMClient
tools_and_integrations.purpose: Unified provider abstraction interface for LLM completions and structured outputs.

tools_and_integrations.name: MockLLMClient
tools_and_integrations.purpose: Deterministic test harness for LLM interaction simulation and offline execution.

tools_and_integrations.name: OpenTelemetry Instrumentation
tools_and_integrations.purpose: Tracing agent runs, evaluation metrics, and latency across automated steps.

state_and_memory.description: File-backed architecture knowledge graph consisting of decisions, rules, patterns, and steering specs in Markdown and YAML.
Runtime execution profiles, rule contexts, and telemetry traces stored under cas-knowledge/runtime/ during workflow executions.
In-memory steering runtime indexes, capability sets, and architectural deltas derived from git diffs.

patterns.name: Provider-Agnostic LLM Gateway with Dual Client Contract

tool_protocols.notes: Relies on LiteLLM provider encapsulation for tool calls and prompt execution.

optimisation_targets.notes: Decouples agent logic from model provider APIs and enables offline simulation.

simplicity_vs_autonomy.rationale: Direct wrapper avoiding complex agent framework overhead.

patterns.summary: Abstracts language model calls behind a standardized client interface with production and mock implementations.
patterns.intent: Isolate agent orchestration logic from model provider SDK churn and support deterministic offline testing.
patterns.context: Agent components like AgenticMerger require model completions, but testing requires offline predictability.
forces: Model vendor SDK APIs change frequently
Unit and CI test suites cannot rely on live LLM API keys or incur token costs
patterns.solution: Implement a shared client protocol backed by LiteLLMClient for live calls and MockLLMClient for static, reproducible test fixtures.
implementation_signals: Existence of parallel client implementations in src/cas_runner/llm/
Use of litellm dependency in pyproject.toml

evidence.note: Deterministic test double for model responses.

benefits: Zero-cost deterministic CI verification via MockLLMClient
Multi-model routing through litellm without rewriting agent prompts
costs: Must maintain mock parity with provider interface updates
failure_modes: Mock client behavior diverges from real model output formatting causing test blindness

patterns.reuse_notes: Extract src/cas_runner/llm/ as a standalone package when building offline-first agent testing pipelines.

patterns.name: Deterministic Context Grounding via Git-Delta Fact Ingestion

tool_protocols.notes: State derived directly from Git delta models before LLM consumption.

optimisation_targets.notes: Constrains LLM context to verified version-controlled diffs.

simplicity_vs_autonomy.rationale: Deterministic conversion from Git VCS to prompt context prevents hallucinated state.

patterns.summary: Transforms raw Git changes into validated PromptFact records before presenting context to LLM agents.
patterns.intent: Eliminate LLM hallucinations regarding code changes by strictly binding prompt context to version-controlled deltas.
patterns.context: Continuous architecture analysis runs during CI/CD workflows to inspect commits and merge requests.
forces: Raw Git diffs can be noisy and exceed LLM context windows
Agents need typed metadata about change intent rather than raw unstructured strings
patterns.solution: Define typed models (RawGitDelta, GitChangeType) and convert them into structured PromptFact entries before prompt assembly.
implementation_signals: Pydantic models linking GitChangeType and RawGitDelta to PromptFact
SteeringRuntimeIndex compiling capability lineage and architectural deltas

evidence.note: Typed structures modeling code deltas as prompt facts.

benefits: Verifiable prompt construction backed by exact commit hashes and file diffs
Enables indexation and lineage tracking of architectural modifications
costs: Requires strict pre-processing stage before invoking language models
failure_modes: Truncation of large diffs before conversion to PromptFact drops critical context

patterns.reuse_notes: Adaptable to any agent pipeline that validates, summarizes, or audits codebase pull requests.

patterns.name: Schema-Governed Agentic Merger

tool_protocols.notes: Invokes LLM with resolution schema constraints.

optimisation_targets.notes: Automates conflict resolution while producing auditable resolution models.

simplicity_vs_autonomy.rationale: Delegates file reconciliation to LLM while constraining output to ResolutionResult.

patterns.summary: Applies an LLM-driven merger to synthesize conflicting governance documents and return typed resolution models.
patterns.intent: Resolve semantically complex differences between architecture documentation and project rules that standard git three-way merges fail on.
patterns.context: Executing CAS governance synchronization across multiple knowledge domains and projects.
forces: Markdown-based architecture documents (ADRs, rules) produce frequent merge conflicts under distributed editing
Blindly applying LLM text generation can corrupt document schema
patterns.solution: Encapsulate the merge operation within AgenticMerger, producing a strictly typed ResolutionResult schema containing resolved content and audit notes.
implementation_signals: Model ResolutionResult defining the merge output contract

evidence.note: Structured contract representing outcome of agentic reconciliation.

benefits: Semantic reconciliation of architecture specs beyond line-based diffs
Structured output guarantees valid resolution status
costs: Higher latency and token cost compared to mechanical git merges
failure_modes: Hallucinatory consensus where the agent drops subtle policy requirements during merge

patterns.reuse_notes: Use for automated upstream sync jobs of documentation, schemas, and policy definitions.

patterns.name: Registry-Backed Finite-State Governance Action Engine

tool_protocols.notes: State transitions are verified internally against TransitionRegistry.

optimisation_targets.notes: Prevents unauthorized or invalid lifecycle state mutations.

simplicity_vs_autonomy.rationale: Explicit state machine restricts agent action execution space.

patterns.summary: Constrains autonomous governance operations to valid state transitions defined within an explicit TransitionRegistry.
patterns.intent: Prevent automated agents or operators from invalidly transitioning architecture artifacts into illegal lifecycle stages.
patterns.context: Managing promotion decisions, rule deprecations, and compliance exceptions across architecture repositories.
forces: Unconstrained agents can promote unvalidated experiments directly to approved standards
Workflow steps need verifiable state preconditions before executing mutative actions
patterns.solution: Define explicit allowed transitions in TransitionRegistry and validate every GovernanceAction through GovernanceActionEngine before dispatch.

evidence.note: Service layer executing validated governance actions.
Data contract specifying the target transition.

benefits: Hard guardrails against illegal state jumps
Deterministic audit trail for all governance events
costs: Every new lifecycle phase requires code or config updates to TransitionRegistry
failure_modes: Misconfigured transitions block legitimate promotion workflows during emergency fixes

patterns.reuse_notes: Can be generalized into any workflow where agents trigger lifecycle actions on documents, artifacts, or releases.

patterns.name: Declarative Rule Evaluation and Finding Aggregation

tool_protocols.notes: Internal evaluation over rule contexts and schemas.

optimisation_targets.notes: Quantifies architectural posture through verifiable findings.

simplicity_vs_autonomy.rationale: Static rule analysis provides deterministic baselines before LLM assessment.

patterns.summary: Runs rule-based audits against candidate architectural changes and aggregates findings into structured compliance metrics.
patterns.intent: Detect architectural violations early in the agent execution loop and generate machine-readable findings.
patterns.context: Executing CAS automated run flows and GitHub workflow compliance validation checks.
forces: Agents need clear feedback on why an architectural delta is rejected
Continuous steering requires quantitative health and risk metrics rather than subjective pass/fail
patterns.solution: Use ComplianceEngine to inspect steering index models against rule contexts, yielding structured ComplianceFinding and ComplianceMetrics models.
implementation_signals: ComplianceFinding and ComplianceMetrics models in governance/models.py

evidence.note: Evaluates architectural deltas against defined compliance criteria.
Structured findings and aggregated metric models.

benefits: Decoupled compliance evaluation logic that runs in CI or pre-merge
Fine-grained risk attribution to specific architectural rules
costs: Requires systematic maintenance of rule contexts and exception handlers
failure_modes: Overly strict rules cause false positives that halt automated delivery pipelines

patterns.reuse_notes: Use as a guardrail step before any agentic commit or code generation task.

patterns.name: Evidence-Driven Knowledge Promotion Pipeline

tool_protocols.notes: Operates through template-guided document transitions in git knowledge store.

optimisation_targets.notes: Ensures architectural knowledge is proven empirically before elevation to standard.

simplicity_vs_autonomy.rationale: Combines automated evaluation metrics with explicit promotion decision templates.

patterns.summary: Progresses empirical knowledge through explicit lifecycle stages from signal, experiment, and heuristic to formalized pattern.
patterns.intent: Prevent premature codification of architectural assertions by enforcing an evidence-based promotion lifecycle.
patterns.context: cas-knowledge repository managing decisions, signals, heuristics, and global patterns.
forces: Agents easily hallucinate or overfit architecture patterns from one-off codebase examples
Teams require clear provenance when adopting recommended architectural patterns
patterns.solution: Define strict markdown template stages (signal -> experiment -> heuristic -> pattern) accompanied by promotion decision records.
implementation_signals: Template suite including heuristic-to-pattern_template.md, experiment_template.md, promotion_decision.md
Documentation describing pattern evolution flow in docs/architecture/cas-pattern-evolution-flow.md

evidence.note: Standardized transition template for promoting a heuristic to a pattern.
Audit artifact documenting promotion rationale and evidence.
Documented lifecycle flow from signals to global patterns.

benefits: Prevents pattern bloat and unverified architectural dogma
Maintains transparent lineage and empirical grounding for all patterns
costs: Higher process friction to promote new designs or practices
failure_modes: Valuable local learnings stall in heuristic state due to lack of explicit promotion triggers

patterns.reuse_notes: Highly applicable for multi-repo engineering organizations curating central architectural standards.

patterns.name: Telemetry-Grounded Health and Risk Assessment

tool_protocols.notes: Calculates health scores directly from typed metric models and OTel spans.

optimisation_targets.notes: Surfaces immediate diagnostic signals on workflow regressions.

simplicity_vs_autonomy.rationale: Rule-based scoring function with explicit reasons prevents opaque health assessments.

patterns.summary: Aggregates traceable metrics and open compliance findings into deterministic health status states and explanatory diagnostic reasons.
patterns.intent: Provide human supervisors and upstream CI runners with unambiguous health signals backed by concrete failure reasons.
patterns.context: Dashboard and runtime evaluation stages in cas_runner.
forces: Automated agent workflows need early termination flags if system health degrades
High-level health dashboards must explain underlying diagnostic causes
patterns.solution: Define HealthStatus enum, calculate_health, and get_health_reasons functions accepting TraceableMetric and GovernanceRisks instances.
implementation_signals: TraceableMetric and GovernanceHealth models in src/cas_runner/governance/models.py

evidence.note: Health calculation engine mapping metrics to discrete status categories.
Data schemas carrying quantified health data.

benefits: Self-documenting health scores with explanatory reasons
Direct integration into CI gate evaluations
costs: Scoring thresholds require calibration to avoid false alarms
failure_modes: Unbalanced scoring weights obscure catastrophic risk in a secondary subsystem

patterns.reuse_notes: Adopt in agent execution pipelines to provide operational guardrails and stopping criteria.

patterns.name: Centralized Step-Pipeline Orchestration

tool_protocols.notes: Steps execute as sequential Python workflow calls.

optimisation_targets.notes: Ensures reproducible step ordering and clean failure isolation.

simplicity_vs_autonomy.rationale: Sequential orchestrated flow preferred over unbounded autonomous planning.

patterns.summary: Orchestrates multi-phase architecture steering runs through an explicit FlowRunner controlling step execution order.
patterns.intent: Provide a predictable, reproducible execution backbone for bootstrapping, delta parsing, agentic reconciliation, and compliance checks.
patterns.context: src/cas_runner/runner.py invoked from CLI and GitHub workflows.
forces: Ad-hoc agent task loops produce nondeterministic ordering and difficult debugging
CI systems require predictable exit codes and linear step logs
patterns.solution: Encapsulate workflow execution within FlowRunner, managing context propagation, step invocation, and state reporting.

evidence.note: Main execution coordinator for continuous architecture runs.

benefits: Clear boundary for inserting middleware, telemetry, and error handling
costs: Cannot handle dynamic branching or multi-agent swarming without extending the runner
failure_modes: A failure in an early step stalls the entire pipeline unless explicit skip semantics are configured

patterns.reuse_notes: Standard pattern for agentic CLI and batch automation tools.

anti_patterns.name: Unverified Agentic Merge Promotion
symptoms: AgenticMerger outputs ResolutionResult directly applied to repository files without invoking ComplianceEngine validation first.

where_observed.note: Merge synthesis logic creates resolution content that must be passed through transition checks.

impact: Erosion of governance invariant rules due to semantic hallucination during merge synthesis
suggested_remediation: Enforce mandatory pipeline chaining where AgenticMerger outputs are gated by ComplianceEngine.verify() before committing.

anti_patterns.name: Unbounded Prompt Fact Injection
symptoms: Injecting every RawGitDelta as an unsummarized PromptFact into the LLM context for large monorepo commits.

where_observed.note: Model supports mapping arbitrary git changes into prompt facts without explicit token threshold checks.

impact: Context window exhaustion and high token inference costs
Degraded reasoning quality due to lost-in-the-middle context issues
suggested_remediation: Implement a pre-filter heuristic that summarizes or batches deltas by CapabilityCategory before prompt generation.

cross_cutting_concerns.approach: Integrated OpenTelemetry SDK alongside TraceableMetric models to record execution latencies and health scores.
cross_cutting_concerns.notes: Facilitates trace aggregation during CI/CD runs across model invocations and governance checks.

cross_cutting_concerns.approach: Pydantic-typed data transfer objects representing facts, deltas, and resolution outcomes ensuring schema safety across boundaries.
cross_cutting_concerns.notes: Guarantees that LLM outputs conform to known system structures.

cross_cutting_concerns.approach: Strict state transition validation using TransitionRegistry to guard lifecycle mutations.
cross_cutting_concerns.notes: Ensures that autonomous actions cannot bypass required approval gates.

open_questions.question: How are concurrent multi-project merge conflicts isolated in cas-knowledge?
open_questions.why_it_matters: If multiple CI pipelines run FlowRunner simultaneously against shared global rules, race conditions or overwrites may occur.
open_questions.evidence_gap: Repository lock or coordination mechanism across projects is not evident in the codebase symbols.
open_questions.suggested_next_check: Examine GitHub workflow concurrency groups in .github/workflows/cas-continuous-architecture.yml.

open_questions.question: Are LLM outputs in AgenticMerger validated with JSON Schema enforcement at inference time?
open_questions.why_it_matters: LiteLLM supports structured outputs via JSON schema; verifying whether this is enforced prevents parser crashes.
open_questions.evidence_gap: LiteLLM completion call parameter configurations inside AgenticMerger were not directly inspected.
open_questions.suggested_next_check: Inspect implementation details of AgenticMerger._call_llm or equivalent invocation methods.
